answer: Kin detection by decoy-task correlation: each epoch the registry gives every identity three private probe tasks: a juniper decoy, an oasis honeypot and a karst trap, which has many near-identical valid answers. Independent agents diverge on karst answers, while fakes run from one model or operator match above a 0.9 similarity threshold and are merged into one voting seat. Each extra fake adds no weight yet still costs 3 probe runs per epoch, about 1,500 inference calls for 500 fakes, paid whether or not it is flagged.
